definitions: The ability to understand the health, quality, and state of data within a system.
A set of tools and practices for monitoring and managing the quality and reliability of data pipelines and datasets.
The practice of gaining insights into the entire data lifecycle, from ingestion to consumption, to proactively identify and resolve data issues.
examples: Implementing data observability improved our data quality.
Many companies are investing in data observability platforms.
Data observability is crucial for maintaining trust in data-driven decisions.
